question: Which of the following hills is located in the Eastern Ghats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shevaroy hills**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Shevaroy hills are a prominent range of hills located in the Eastern Ghats in Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• These hills are situated near the town of Yercaud, which is a popular hill station known for its scenic beauty and pleasant climate.
 
• The Shevaroy hills are part of the Eastern Ghats, which is a discontinuous range of mountains along India's eastern coast.
 
• The highest peak in the Shevaroy hills is Solaikaradu, which stands at an elevation of 1,620 meters (5,315 feet).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Naga hills**

 
 
• The Naga hills are located in the northeastern part of India, primarily in the state of Nagaland and partially in Myanmar.
 
• They form part of the larger Patkai mountain range and are known for their rich biodiversity and cultural heritage.
 
• The highest peak in the Naga hills is Mount Saramati, which stands at an elevation of 3,826 meters (12,552 feet).
 
 
 
• **Khasi hills**
 
 
• The Khasi hills are located in the state of Meghalaya in northeastern India.
 
• They are part of the larger Garo-Khasi-Jaintia range and are known for their unique matrilineal culture and living root bridges.
 
• The highest peak in the Khasi hills is Shillong Peak, which stands at an elevation of 1,965 meters (6,447 feet).
 
 
 
• **Anamudi hills**
 
 
• Anamudi is the highest peak in the Western Ghats and South India, located in the state of Kerala.
 
• It stands at an elevation of 2,695 meters (8,842 feet) and is situated in the Eravikulam National Park.
 
• Being part of the Western Ghats, it is not associated with the Eastern Ghats.
